title_en: Lynx Preview: How a New Cyberpunk Manga Fuses the Noir Atmosphere of Blade Runner With the Emotional Mystery of Pluto
summary_en: Check out our exclusive preview of Lynx, a new manga series that combines the best elements of Blade Runner and Pluto into one appealing package.
body_en:
Viz Media is set to kick off a new manga series called Lynx. Not only is Lynx billed as a neo-noir mash-up of Blade Runner and Pluto, it even features a detective heroine with a talking, crime-fighting cat for a partner. What's not to love?
With Lynx Vol. 1 now in stores, IGN can exclusively debut a new preview of the book. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
Lynx is written by Samuel Sattin (Buzzing) and illustrated by tokitokoro (Jeff the Land Shark). Here's the official summary of the first volume:
Lynx Vol. 1 is available in stores now. You can order a copy on Amazon .
Sattin is also the writer behind the Unico series , which reboots a classic Osamu Tezuka property for a modern audience. For more manga fun, be sure to check out the most terrifying manga by Juni Ito .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
